# Orbit Dashboard

Synthetic TypeScript + React project used only for the Melly IDE native showcase.

- `src/App.tsx` renders the dashboard shell
- `src/lib/approvals.ts` models per-run approval state
- `tests/approvals.test.ts` covers the approval rules

No dependencies are installed. No provider calls. No private data.
